name: Map Pin
summary: A map marker with a round disc and a stem below it.
description: A location marker made of a circular disc sitting above a straight stem, the disc holding either a line-art icon or a real photo. A photo shows through at a lower tint than an icon does, since a photo needs to stay visible on its own rather than compete with a solid wash of color.
whenToUse: Marking a location on a map with an icon or a photo
Making a marker clickable to open more detail about that location
whenNotToUse: Labeling a point with visible text next to it — the pin has no text slot of its own
Showing a location that isn't clickable — a plain static marker may not need the button behavior

content.icon: Holds a simple line-art glyph, tinted at half strength.
content.photo: Holds a real photograph, tinted lighter so the image reads clearly.

states.focus: A thick outline appears around the whole pin for keyboard focus.

dos: Give it a label describing the place it marks, for screen readers.
Use the photo variant's lighter tint when the image itself needs to read clearly.
donts: Don't nest the stem inside the disc. Keep them as siblings.
Don't rely on a browser's default focus ring. It won't show against the photo.

keyboard: Enter / Space activates, same as any button
notes: Give it a label naming the place it marks — the disc has no visible text a screen reader could fall back on.
